name: context-menu
title: Context Menu
description: A right-click menu drawn as the dashboard's menus: a framed panel of roomy muted rows with caption labels, shortcuts and red destructive rows.
usage: Offer the actions of a row or an object where people already right-click: a monitor in a list, a file in a batch, a node in a JSON tree. Every action here must also be reachable another way (a row's menu button), since right-click is hidden and absent on touch.
avoid: Long menus (more than about ten rows)
Icons on some rows and not others in the same group

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
